title: Wang–Ostrik Finiteness Conjecture for Fusion Categories
exact_target: For each prescribed number of simple objects, decide whether only finitely many fusion and ribbon categories can occur.

rank-finiteness for modular categories; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The fixed-rank parameter ranges over positive integers. The report distinguishes the characteristic-zero setting from positive characteristic, and its rank-two and ribbon-rank-three results are special cases rather than proof of the full conjecture.
